candidates.source_title: The Gun That Was Taller Than Big Ben #history #ww2 #engineering
candidates.source_description:
The German V3 supergun was a massive artillery piece designed to bombard London from across the English Channel.

We analyze the engineering behind this weapon, which featured a barrel comparable in height to Big Ben. This objective look at the firing mechanism explains how a series of side chambers and explosive charges were used to accelerate shells toward their target.
